verdict.rationale: Raygun's own docs list "Sending dSYMS to Raygun" and "Uploading ProGuard mapping files" as services that use the external access token, so dSYM and ProGuard uploads are a documented first-party capability. The only evidence is that passing mention on the access-token page; nothing describes the upload workflow or the symbolicated output. Native debug symbols such as PDB or Breakpad files are not evidenced at all. missing for 10: native debug symbol upload support, documentation of the dSYM/ProGuard upload workflow and resulting function/line symbolication, independent or hands-on corroboration.
